build.note: next.config.mjs has ignoreBuildErrors: true, so a build pass would not be meaningful evidence.

key_product_behavior_findings.title: XP/level progression double-award race condition
key_product_behavior_findings.evidence: postActivityLog reads existing xpLog, then inserts xpLog and updates users.xp/level in separate non-atomic statements. Two concurrent requests can both observe no existing xpLog and both award XP.
key_product_behavior_findings.impact: Students can game level, leaderboards, and streaks by replaying or parallelizing activity-completion requests.

key_product_behavior_findings.title: Level-test assessment JSON not validated
key_product_behavior_findings.evidence: parseAssessment returns object | null with no Zod schema. Frontend accesses assessmentData.level/sublevel/xp without contract guarantees.
key_product_behavior_findings.impact: Malformed AI output can corrupt user level/CEFR or trap student in level-test loop.

key_product_behavior_findings.title: AI-generated content lacks level/quality gate
key_product_behavior_findings.evidence: Generators use temperature: 1 and random seed; no post-hoc CEFR/readability validation; raw string throws instead of Error instances.
key_product_behavior_findings.impact: Students may receive off-level articles or inconsistent questions; error handling breaks standard logging.

key_product_behavior_findings.title: Assignment status mapping ad-hoc and not source-of-truth aligned
key_product_behavior_findings.evidence: Local statusToInt helper maps strings to ints; no shared enum between DB schema, API, and UI.
key_product_behavior_findings.impact: Progress reports and assignment funnels can disagree with actual student status.

key_product_behavior_findings.title: Class accuracy report combines incommensurable score types
key_product_behavior_findings.evidence: overallAccuracy = (mcqCorrect + openEndedCorrect) / totalAttempts where MCQ is binary and open-ended is threshold-based.
key_product_behavior_findings.impact: Teacher-facing accuracy metric is mathematically misleading.

key_product_behavior_findings.title: Open-ended scoring threshold arbitrary and undocumented
key_product_behavior_findings.evidence: Hard-coded details?.score >= 3 || details?.rating >= 3 with no shared rubric enum.
key_product_behavior_findings.impact: Reported 'correct' open-ended answers may not match AI feedback rubric.

key_product_behavior_findings.title: Activity targetId resolution fragile
key_product_behavior_findings.evidence: targetId is inferred from articleId || storyId || contentId || '' then details.articleId; special-cased for rating prefixes.
key_product_behavior_findings.impact: Progress and XP can be misattributed to the wrong artifact.

key_product_behavior_findings.title: License-level fallback treats missing data as Enterprise
key_product_behavior_findings.evidence: getUserLicenseLevel returns LicenseType.ENTERPRISE when expiredDate is null, even without a licenseId.
key_product_behavior_findings.impact: Missing-license users may receive Enterprise feature gating; LAQ may be required for article completion incorrectly.

key_product_behavior_findings.title: Report controllers use unsafe type casts on session/params
key_product_behavior_findings.evidence: (req as any).session and (req as any).params accesses; requireRole([...] as any) calls.
key_product_behavior_findings.impact: Route/middleware drift can cause runtime auth bypass or crashes.

key_product_behavior_findings.title: No product-level learning-outcome tests
key_product_behavior_findings.evidence: 0 tests verify article completion, XP idempotency, level progression, FSRS scheduling, assignment lifecycle, or AI content level validation.
key_product_behavior_findings.impact: Core learning loops have no automated regression protection; refactoring into domain layer is high-risk.

caveats: This review did not remediate app code; it produced audit artifacts and proposed tracks only.
Shared-foundation Critical findings (tenant registry drift, API/type contract drift, null-tenant TenantDB, API business-logic leakage) remain caveats for any reading-advantage remediation.
The full test suite timed out; targeted file evidence should not be treated as full-suite green.
next.config.mjs has ignoreBuildErrors: true, so build success is not a meaningful correctness gate.
No browser/UX manual validation was performed; UI-only product bugs may exist.
